visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man and woman are seated on a bright yellow sofa in a cozy, well-lit living room. The woman, in a pink sweater, excitedly holds a white mug with a couple's photo, while the man, wearing a black Mickey Mouse sweatshirt, smiles at her. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of a black tiered shelf filled with numerous identical white mugs, each featuring different photos and colorful text labels. The camera zooms into specific mugs briefly. (3) Returning to the sofa, the man proudly displays two T-shirts—one black, one pink—both printed with their photos. The woman's expression transforms from excitement to a flat, unimpressed stare as she holds the pink shirt. (4) In a new sequence with different outfits, the man in a white sweatshirt hands the woman a folded white paper. She opens it with a look of pure bewilderment. (5) The man presents a small potted plant with yellow flowers; the woman holds it with a stiff, unenthusiastic posture. (6) In the final shot, the man hands her a white digital floor scale. The woman reacts with an aggressive, wide-mouthed shout directed at the man.
